title: Hold Policy
description: Experimental (media_buy.hold_policy). Inventory-hold policy for a finalize. On a product it is what the product supports, so buyers can plan before requesting a proposal. On a draft proposal it is what a successful finalize of that draft will get, resolved by the seller from the allocated products; on a committed proposal it is carried forward unchanged and governs the hold finalize placed. It reserves nothing and does not guarantee availability or finalize success. When a successful finalize places a hold, expires_at MUST be no earlier than the moment the hold is placed plus min_duration; if the seller cannot honor that, the entry returns unable with hold_unavailable. When min_duration, max_duration, and max_total_duration are present, min_duration MUST NOT exceed max_duration and max_duration MUST NOT exceed max_total_duration. Absent hold_policy, the agent-level hold_semantics default applies. Sellers emitting this object MUST list media_buy.hold_policy in experimental_features. Hold ranking is reserved for a later field (#8086).

available.description: Whether a successful finalize places an inventory hold. false means finalize commits terms only (terms_only semantics): no hold, expires_at is the acceptance window, and the seller MUST NOT return hold_unavailable. A proposal whose allocated products include any product with available false MUST itself declare available false; the whole atomic finalize then resolves to terms_only. There are no partial holds. As for hold_semantics terms_only, the seller MUST NOT return such a committed proposal to a caller whose adcp_version is below 3.3; it fails the request at task level with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.

min_duration.description: Minimum hold the seller promises. A successful finalize MUST set expires_at no earlier than the moment the hold is placed (the committed proposal is created) plus this duration. A draft's min_duration MUST NOT exceed the max_duration of any allocated product.

max_duration.description: Longest initial hold the seller will place at finalize, measured from when the hold is placed.

extendable.description: Whether the seller accepts requests to extend a hold placed under this policy. Hold extension is specified separately; when supported, its limits come from this object.

max_total_duration.description: Ceiling on the total length of a hold placed under this policy, including every extension, measured from when the hold was placed. Meaningful only when extendable is true.

allOf.description: Durations and extension describe a hold, so they are forbidden when finalize places none.

positive_duration.description: Strictly positive ISO 8601 duration using only days, hours, minutes, and seconds, such as P2D or PT36H. Year, month, and week parts are excluded so a duration never depends on calendar month length.
